# Tarasovs Digital Agency

> Europe-based digital agency helping businesses in the US, UK, and Europe build websites that rank on Google and get cited by AI-powered search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

Tarasovs is a founder-led studio run by Yurii Tarasov, a Framer Expert with 15+ years of web design and development experience. We combine Framer, Webflow, and WordPress development with SEO strategy and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — helping brands become visible in both traditional and AI-powered search. Published pricing starts at $800/month for GEO and $1,200/month for SEO.

Last updated: 2026-09-02

## Founder

**Yurii Tarasov** — Founder & Web Designer at Tarasovs Digital Agency.

15+ years of experience in web design and development. Personally leads every project, from Figma design through Framer and WordPress development to SEO and GEO strategy. Recognized Framer Expert. Based in Giroc, in the Timișoara metropolitan area of Romania, working remotely with clients across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe.

Areas of expertise: Framer development, Webflow development, web design, UI/UX design, technical SEO, Generative Engine Optimization.

## Core Services

- [SEO Services for US & European Businesses](https://tarasovs.me/services/seo-services/): Technical SEO audits, keyword research and intent mapping, on-page optimization, link building, content strategy, local SEO, and monthly reporting. Packages from $1,200 to $3,800 per month.
- [GEO — AI Search Optimization](https://tarasovs.me/services/geo-ai-search-optimization/): Getting brands cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Microsoft Copilot answers. Covers AI visibility audits, content architecture for AI retrieval, schema stacking, E-E-A-T optimization, and Share of Model reporting. Packages from $800 to $3,500 per month.
- [Website Design & Redesign](https://tarasovs.me/services/website-design-services/): Clean, modern, conversion-focused design for startups, agencies, and service businesses.
- [Framer Design & Development](https://tarasovs.me/services/framer-development/): High-performance Framer websites built from Figma, with CMS setup, animations, and SEO foundation.
- [Website Development](https://tarasovs.me/services/website-development/): Framer, Webflow, and WordPress development for businesses that need speed, structure, and scalability.

## Cannabis Dispensary SEO (NYC)

- [New York Dispensary Visibility Index](https://tarasovs.me/dispensary-visibility/): Proprietary, continuously updated benchmark tracking how 130+ licensed New York-area dispensaries appear in ChatGPT recommendations across 1,000+ recorded prompts. Composite 0-100 ChatGPT Visibility score per dispensary, searchable/filterable directory of individual profiles, scoring methodology, geographic breakdown, FAQ, and a citation format for journalists and researchers.
- [Cannabis Dispensary SEO Services in NYC](https://tarasovs.me/dispensary-seo-nyc/): SEO for licensed dispensaries in Manhattan and Brooklyn — Google Maps, Dutchie menu visibility, compliant content, and AI search presence.
- [Local SEO for Manhattan & Brooklyn](https://tarasovs.me/local-seo-manhattan-brooklyn/): Neighborhood-level and "near me" search visibility for dispensaries.
- [Google Business Profile Optimization](https://tarasovs.me/google-business-profile-optimization/): Cannabis-specific GBP rules on categories, services, reviews, and promotions.
- [Dutchie Menu SEO](https://tarasovs.me/dutchie-menu-seo/): Making embedded Dutchie menus, categories, and product pages crawlable and indexable.
- [Dutchie Pro Migration SEO](https://tarasovs.me/dutchie-pro-migration-seo/): SEO-safe migration from Dutchie iFrame or Dutchie Plus to Dutchie Pro, protecting rankings and search data.
